author: Aria
purpose: Behavior-preserving implementation amendments to T0; no user-visible scope expansion and no request to restart design.

decisions.review: Dara validates V21 implementation; PO checks AC-3 wording
decisions.decision: Add translation continuation REPLAYING_PREFIX. Keep session REPLAYING_PREFIX across every prefix micro-operation; route existing plans endpoint to prefix branch. Exit atomically to SOURCE_PLAN once.
acceptance: No gateway reservation after observation/admission/dispatch callbacks while prefix active.
Coordinator restart continues next unconsumed prefix coordinate.
Concurrent transition calls yield one effective boundary and zero repeated sends.

decisions.review: Dara validates frozen storage; PO identifies existing context reference meaning, including vault:// examples
decisions.decision: Use existing references JSON for a complete authoredDeclarations identity; retain legacy-named variables/secrets arrays because V17 consumes them, without retaining v1 authoring API. Extend AuthoringRevisionIdentity for text-token plain values.

proposedRecord.variables: existing string array for replay/V17 compatibility, semantics unchanged
proposedRecord.secrets: existing opaque secretId string array; no values

constraints: Resolve context references only from declared server-approved identity, never URI suffix guessing or live draft data for base.
Token secret referenceId equals actual opaque secretId. Alias/URI context mapping must have an explicit approved mapping.
Base missing declaration/value hash refuses reuse. A client may explicitly request full learn from step 1; never silently relabel full learn as incremental success.
Do not add a revision column or mutate historical rows.
acceptance: Text-token-only plain value edit changes k at that step.
Changing declared secretId used via context changes k with immutable base mapping.
Token secret bases remain recoverable.
Counterexample old context-only base refuses without draft reads or writes.

decisions.review: Dara must validate DDL/guard footprint; PO validates same session/browser and suffix causal ordering
decisions.decision: Create immutable version history within the existing session/context; append inputs after suffix SOURCE_PLAN, never replace previously materialized inputs. Keep model-free prefix bootstrap.

versionRecord.contextRevision: monotonic positive integer, increases exactly once per append commit
versionRecord.materializationRevision: existing metadata revision monotonic, increases when allocations/producers/edges or inputs append
versionRecord.sourceRevision: current frozen draft revision, unchanged entire session
versionRecord.configurationRevision: current frozen draft configuration, unchanged entire session
versionRecord.authoredInputsHash: SHA-256 of exact authoredInputs at this version
versionRecord.authoredInputs: complete bounded array with old entries byte-identical and new entries appended
versionRecord.previousInputsHash: null at version 1; exact prior authoredInputsHash thereafter

decisions.storage: Dara-owned forward V21 history table keyed (session_id,context_revision), plus guard that current materialization points at an append-only validated history version. Keep contextId/worker/fence/source/config fixed; no history update/delete. Initial materialization is captured as version 1.
validation: Inputs remain <=200 and existing byte limits; union de-duplicates exact provenance and retains existing inputId.
Prefix inputIds copied only from server-verified unchanged base recipe; values resolved fresh. Suffix fresh input IDs cannot collide.
Runner update checks unchanged prior entries, exact prior hash, higher contextRevision, no inflight action, same recorded browser/context, then adds redaction for new values.
Every preparation stores its actual contextRevision/input hash; builder validates against that immutable version, not only latest context. Earlier receipt bytes are unchanged.
No value or secret value enters model projection; secret inputs still have no value field.
Append is one idempotent transaction, context delivery acknowledgement idempotent, no browser restart/bootstrap reset.
acceptance: Edited suffix requires a new sourceSpan absent from prefix; learns and publishes on same recording.
Changing/removing an old input or rebasing its ID is refused.
Concurrent append/retry produces one version and one delivery identity.
Old prefix preparation joins old input hash; final candidate joins all versions exactly.

decisions.review: PO confirms unchanged k/reuse promise; Dara checks storage checks unaffected
decisions.decision: Use learned content envelope {actions,producedBindings,consumedBindings}. producedBindings contains producer-local definitions with consumers removed; consumedBindings contains semantic edges whose consumer coordinate belongs to this step. Remove only exact ephemeral admission/session paths from each. Full learnedPlanHash commits the complete graph.
decisions.producedFields: All binding fields except consumers and provenance.sessionId/provenance.producerAdmissionId; preserve bindingId,valueType,producer,recipe,sourceOrigin,provenance.sourceIntentStepId,transferPolicy,preserveBytes and future semantic fields.
decisions.consumerFields: All consumer-edge fields except producerAdmissionId and consumerAdmissionId; includes bindingId,coordinate,argumentSlot,destinationOrigin,transferPolicy. Sort by coordinate ordinal then argumentSlot then bindingId; sourceSteps determines step order.
decisions.reason: A suffix consumer changes its own snapshot and chain only. A reused prefix producer snapshot stays byte-identical. No semantic edge escapes the overall graph commitment.
acceptance: Step-2 binding consumed at step4: changing/deleting consumer leaves step2 snapshot equal and step4+ different.
Changing producer recipe changes producer snapshot.
New-session receipt IDs change admission provenance but not stable prefix hash.
No old suffix consumers imported into allocation; seed reused prefix obligations/producers only, append current-draft consumers after suffix plan.

decisions.topic: No-invocation drift receipt and at-most-once transition
decisions.review: Dara validates admission uniqueness/immutable receipt DDL; PO confirms no repeated prefix browser effects
decisions.decision: A target/observation refusal proven before native invocation may transition to suffix learning without stopping the recorded browser. Keep the spent admission immutable and never resend it. A fresh learned replacement admission may execute the still-unperformed semantic operation; every actual native effect occurs at most once. If invocation began or its status is unknown, stop UNKNOWN_OUTCOME. Assertion/policy failure stops even when no effect occurred.

receipt.receiptHash: hash of all preceding receipt fields

decisions.recording: No-invocation receipt has no fabricated completed effect timing; existing recording continues. Failed native or lost acknowledgement never creates this receipt.
decisions.persistence: Forward V21 must add immutable no-invocation receipt and admission-attempt identity, not overwrite failed/successful history. Proposed uniqueness becomes (session,step,semantic ordinal,attempt ordinal); at most one invoked/live attempt at a coordinate. New attempt requires all previous attempts at that coordinate to have authenticated no-invocation proof. Each admission dispatchCount remains <=1. Existing obligation coordinate uniqueness likewise needs attempt distinction; old plan records stay immutable.
decisions.publication: Effective current plan selects one successful executed admission per semantic coordinate. All excluded spent attempts require exact no-invocation receipts and are committed in publicationEvidenceHash. Pure validator verifies no other failed/unknown admission is omitted. admissionProvenanceHash covers effective prefix+suffix execution tuples; evidence hash covers all attempts. No hidden coordinate renumbering.
decisions.cursor: Store effective firstLearnStepId=j, completed successful coordinates before refusal, next semantic ordinal, spent attempt IDs. Retain actual completed operations in step j and learn only remaining obligations. Preserve original session firstLearnStepId=k.
acceptance: Race between prepare and final target check: native invocation count zero for spent admission; new learned replacement invokes once; spent admission never resent.
Same command replay returns same receipt; duplicate transition no extra planning/send.
If native invocation began, no receipt accepted and browser ends UNKNOWN_OUTCOME.
Prefix assertion FAIL and POLICY_REFUSED never transition.
Publication rejects an excluded failure without a valid no-invocation receipt.
Each newly learned step j..k-1 has no reusedFrom entry.

decisions.review: Dara validates retained safe records; PO validates boundary behavior
decisions.decision: k=1 means empty reused prefix and ordinary full guided learning; no prefix state is required when no prefix action exists. Strict tail deletion uses last surviving draft step as k, so suffix is nonempty. Empty draft is rejected by existing invalid contract rule before start writes. READY plus explicit valid firstLearnStepId uses the same mechanism; READY with no re-learn request remains ordinary replay.
decisions.retention: baseRevisionId and initial firstLearnStepId are immutable session document fields. Store drift/relearned summary in immutable learned/publication receipt and retain only bounded IDs/codes in terminal progress via V21 retained-key function extension. Do not keep observations/inputs/model payloads in retained progress.
acceptance: Delete final step: k is last remaining authored step and shorter revision publishes.
Delete every step: no session/budget/publication write.
First learn/k1 has no fake reusedFrom.
Prune terminal mixed session retains result boundary/drift summary and removes volatile materialization/evidence data per governed policy.
decisions.dataCorrection: V17:515 is terminal unlinked USAGE/no-decision guard, not ordinary RELEASE; update V21 evidence wording only.
